findings: P2 | must-fix | src/tui/control.rs:770-788 — Require a visibly drawn risk confirmation before committing force. Enter submits ownership-claim(mode=force) whenever the captured ownership observation still matches, without checking whether the force dialog was rendered. At an 80×7 outer-terminal size, the body is four rows and draw_panel returns without drawing anything at lines 1236-1241; nevertheless Prefix/Ctrl-F followed by Enter revokes the existing owner's authority and grants forced control. The normal input loop also drains queued events before drawing (src/tui.rs:733-736), so queued shortcut/Enter input can take this path before the warning appears even at ordinary sizes. This violates the non-waived requirement for a deliberate, warned force confirmation; the daemon correctly compares authority but cannot supply the missing native presentation. Minimal correction: bind confirmation eligibility to an actual, sufficiently visible draw of the risk warning for that captured target/observation, and consume Enter without submitting force until that condition holds. Cover both queued pre-draw confirmation and an undrawable small viewport.
